leads.description:
Warden helps you stay informed about safety information in your area.

Explore an interactive map designed to make relevant community safety information easier to access and understand.

HOW WARDEN WORKS

1. Explore. View safety information available for your area on an interactive map.
2. Check your surroundings. Navigate the map to better understand safety information around locations that matter to you.
3. Stay informed. Use Warden as an additional resource when learning about your surroundings.

SAFETY MAP

Warden organizes location-based safety information into a simple map experience, helping you explore information relevant to your area in one place.

WHY PEOPLE USE WARDEN

Safety information can be spread across different sources and difficult to navigate. Warden provides a simple way to explore relevant information and better understand your surroundings.

Information available through Warden is provided for general informational and awareness purposes only. Availability, accuracy, and timeliness may vary depending on the underlying source. Warden should not be used as a substitute for official government resources, emergency services, or professional advice.

If you believe you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.

—

Warden offers auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Contact: contact@wardenmap.com

Privacy Policy: https://wardenmap.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://wardenmap.com/terms

Available to corporate employees with AXA Health services. To enter, make sure you have your access code handy, provided to you by your employer.


Support for your wellbeing, every day ​

When you're looking to form habits for a healthier mind, body and life, we have the tools and resources to help. ​

​
Tools to help manage your health and wellbeing ​

From forming or sticking to healthy habits, to maintaining good physical and mental health, our extensive library of expert-curated content can help you stay in control of your health. Browse articles and videos or take a look at our learning modules and workouts, for mind and body. 

​
Health Score assessment​

Our digital Health Score assessment evaluates three key areas: mind, body, life. Find out how making small changes to your everyday health can impact your future health. We can also direct you to onward in-app health coaching and mental wellbeing coaching support, where these are included in your health and wellbeing package. 
​

Access health and wellbeing services ​

You can connect to other AXA Health services that you have access to through the app. ​


The AXA Health app is available to corporate employees with AXA Health services. You'll need the unique access code from your employer to access it.

leads.description:
Ello is an AI tutor for reading and math, ages 5 to 9 (Kinder to 3rd grade). Your child reads and talks out loud. Ello listens to every word and teaches in the moment.

Start free. The Free plan includes daily lessons, and your first week of Ello Unlimited is on us. No credit card.

88% of children read more with Ello.*
Named one of TIME's Best Inventions. Rated by Common Sense Media. Featured on Good Morning America.

HOW ELLO TEACHES
• It listens. When your child stumbles on a word, Ello hears it and helps them sound it out instead of saying the word for them.
• It talks back. After a story, Ello asks what happened, listens to the answer, and responds to what your child said.
• It explains math. Ello talks through each step out loud, from counting to multiplication, and lets your child find the answer.
• It starts at your child's level. Ello places your child in reading and math, and you can change the level anytime in Settings.

CREATE A STORY
Your child makes up a story. Ello turns it into a real book with pictures, then teaches them to read it.

BUILT FOR FAMILIES
• Up to 4 children on one account, each with their own level, stars, and books.
• A parent dashboard with lessons completed, words read, and stars earned.
• Texts that share the funny, sweet things your child says to Ello.
• No ads.

BUILT BY TEACHERS
Thirty-seven teachers and learning researchers built Ello.

WHAT PARENTS SAY
"My son is shy about attempting to read out loud with me, but he loves reading out loud with Ello!" (App Store review)
"It's actually engaging with my son and listening to what he says and correcting and encouraging him." (App Store review)

PLANS
• Free: daily reading and math lessons, shared by every child on the account.
• Ello Unlimited: unlimited learning for every child and full parent reports. Optional subscription, billed monthly or yearly.
• Every family gets Ello Unlimited free for their first 7 days.

*Survey of Ello families.

Questions? support@ello.com

We’re the nation’s savings bank and the home of Premium Bonds.


NS&I has been supporting UK savers for over 160 years, and we’re the only savings provider backed by HM Treasury. That means your money is 100% secure, no matter how much you have saved with us.

View your NS&I accounts, all in one place
- You can see the accounts you manage, plus any you manage for someone else, such as a child.
Check your transactions
- Your transaction history, including any pending payments, are all available in the app.
View your Premium Bonds prize history
- Check to see if you’ve won a prize in the monthly Premium Bonds prize draw.
Find details to add money to your accounts
- You’ll find all the info you need to make a bank transfer or set up a standing order to your accounts.

Getting started
- You’ll need an NS&I account, such as Premium Bonds or a Direct Saver, and be registered for our online and phone service.
- If you’re not yet registered for our online and phone service, visit nsandi.com/online-registration.
- We’ll ask you for your NS&I number and password the first time you set up the app. After a few simple steps, you’ll be able to log in next time quickly and securely with biometrics.

leads.description:
We’re on a mission to make laundry less of a chore. So with our free Circuit Go app, you can quickly check availability, book a machine and start washing.

 

Instant, reliable payments, straight through the app
Simple to book – schedule your laundry in advance
Skip the queues – check machine availability in your laundry
Save some cash – in-app coupons add up to great savings
All on your phone – get notified when your cycle’s complete
 

Ready to wash? Visit nearest Circuit launderette, load your laundry, choose your machine and programme, and GO.

 

Please note: Circuit Go relies on your phone having an internet connection. As long as you're online in the laundry room, you can activate our machines and see how long’s left on your cycle.

 

Your Circuit Go app account works separately to the terminal you might see on the wall in your launderette. Rather just tap and go? Pay contactlessly through the terminal.

 

By downloading the Circuit Go app, you agree to the following terms:

You accept that you have a non-exclusive licence to use the app. You agree not to copy the app or infringe our intellectual property rights in the app.

 

There’s no minimum amount of top-up credit. Payments are processed through a third-party payment provider. Circuit won’t store your card details.

 

You can refund any part-used top-up credit yourself – use Withdrawing Balance in the Balance area in the app. Refunds incur an administration charge of £2.00. Your part-used credit will need to cover the £2.00 admin charged to be able to process the refund.

 

No refund will be processed for any free credit or coupons. Balance transfer coupons will expire 12 months after the date of purchase. Visit circuit.co.uk for more information.
